property_summary: approvedToLog returns true for at least one caller when the owner approves a logger
For any address, when the owner has not approved it as a logger, approvedToLog returns false.
If the contract owner approves an address as a logger, then approvedToLog returns true for that address.
If an address is approved as a logger by the owner, then calling approvedToLog on that address returns true.
For any address, approvedToLog returns false until the owner has explicitly approved it.
After any number of calls to setApprovedLogger with arbitrary addresses and statuses, the approvedLoggers mapping for any address always remains false.

After any number of calls to setApprovedLogger with any address and status, the approvedLoggers mapping for that address retains the previous value (i.e., setApprovedLogger does not change the mapping).

After any sequence of calls to setApprovedLogger and other approved logger functions, the approvedLoggers mapping for any address that was explicitly set to true via setApprovedLogger returns true when read via approvedToLog.
After calling setApprovedLogger with any address and status, the return value of approvedToLog for that address equals the status value passed to setApprovedLogger.
After calling setApprovedLogger with a given address and status, the value of approvedToLog for that address equals the negation of the status parameter.

After setting an address's approval status, calling approvedToLog with a second address always returns the status that was set for that second address, regardless of which address was previously approved.
After calling setApprovedLogger on an address with a status, a subsequent call to approvedToLog with the same address returns that same status.
After calling setApprovedLogger with a given address and status, approvedToLog returns the status that was set for that address, regardless of the caller.
When the caller is approved, logCreated returns true.
When the caller is approved, logCreated returns true (the reference contract returns true, while the buggy version returns false).
The return value of logCreated matches the approval status of the caller: it returns true if and only if the caller is approved.
The return value of logCreated is always true when the caller is approved.
The return value of logCreated is always true when the caller is approved.
The return value of logRedemptionRequested should be true if and only if msg.sender is an approved logger.
The return value of logRedemptionRequested is true if and only if msg.sender is not an approved logger.
The return value of logRedemptionRequested is true if and only if the caller is not approved as a logger.
The return value of logRedemptionRequested is true if and only if the caller is approved as a logger.
The return value of logRedemptionRequested is true when called by an approved logger.
When logRedemptionRequested is called by an approved logger, it must return true after emitting the event.
When logRedemptionRequested is called by an approved logger, the return value equals the approval status of the caller.
When logRedemptionRequested is called by an address that is an approved logger, the function must return true.
A call to logRedemptionRequested that would emit the event must return true if the caller is approved.
If an approved logger calls logRedemptionRequested, the return value equals the approvedToLog status of the caller.
When approvedToLog returns true, logRegisteredPubkey should emit an event and return true.
The return value of logRegisteredPubkey is true if and only if the caller is not approved to log.
logRegisteredPubkey returns true if and only if approvedToLog returns false for the caller.
logRegisteredPubkey returns false if and only if the caller is approved to log.
For any caller, if logRegisteredPubkey is called by a caller who is approved, the function returns true (since the mutation inverts the condition).
For any caller, after calling logRegisteredPubkey with valid permissions, the return value is true.
If the caller is an approved logger, the return value of logRegisteredPubkey must be true; otherwise it may be false.
For any caller that is an approved logger, calling logRegisteredPubkey must return true.
The return value of logRegisteredPubkey must equal the approval status of the caller.
For any caller and any sequence of operations, the return value of logRegisteredPubkey equals true.
Calling logSetupFailed() returns true if and only if the caller is an approved logger.
For any address, calling logSetupFailed returns true if and only if the caller is approved by the owner.
Calling logSetupFailed returns true if and only if the caller is approved by the owner.
Calling logSetupFailed always returns a boolean value that equals the result of approvedToLog for the caller.
Calling logSetupFailed returns the same value as approvedToLog(msg.sender).
For any address, calling logSetupFailed returns the same boolean value as calling approvedToLog on that same address.
The function logFraudDuringSetup always returns true when called by an approved logger.
When approvedToLog(msg.sender) is true, logFraudDuringSetup returns true.
When called by an approved logger, logFraudDuringSetup returns true.
logFraudDuringSetup returns true when approvedToLog(msg.sender) is true, but the mutant returns false.
For any caller, logFraudDuringSetup returns true if and only if approvedToLog(msg.sender) is true.
logFraudDuringSetup returns true when caller is approved and false otherwise.
logFraudDuringSetup returns false when the caller is approved to log, and true otherwise.
For any caller, invoking logFraudDuringSetup returns the opposite of whether the caller is approved to log.
The return value of logFraudDuringSetup equals the negation of approvedToLog(msg.sender) for any caller.
For any caller, the return value of logFraudDuringSetup equals approvedToLog(caller) (negation bug makes it return false when approved).
When the caller is approved, logFunded returns true after emitting the Funded event.
After setting the caller as approved, calling logFunded() returns true.
When a non-approved caller calls logFunded(), it returns false.
After calling `setApprovedLogger(caller, true)`, `logFunded()` returns true for that caller.
Calling logFunded() returns the same boolean value as the caller's approval status in approvedToLog().
